'''Rashtah''' was a [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Slavery/Legends|slave trader]] and an associate and bodyguard of the crime lord [[Krayn]]. Involvement in such a 'profession' was, of course, unusual for a Wookiee.

In [[29 BBY/Legends|29 BBY]], Rashtah accompanied Krayn to [[Rorak 5/Legends|Rorak 5]] for a business meeting with the [[Colicoid/Legends|Colicoids]], who sought total control over the spice operations on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]. Krayn directed Rashtah to monitor the movements of the slave trader "[[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Bakleeda]]," an advisor to the Colicoids who was tasked with inspecting the crime lord's factories on the "Smuggler's Moon."

After an intense struggle, Rashtah was [[Death/Legends|killed]] in a [[Turbolift/Legends|turbolift]] within the slave factories of [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] by "Bakleeda" ([[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] in disguise), whom the Wookiee had attacked at the behest of Krayn.

Rashtah had a scar that ran from his head to his lip; a battle-damaged eye was covered by an eyepatch.

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Although ''[[Jedi Quest: Path to Truth]]'' depicts Rashtah with a scar running through his [[Eye/Legends|eye]] and wearing an [[Eye patch/Legends|eye patch]], in the [[Star Wars: Jedi Quest (comic series)|''Jedi Quest'' comic]] series he is depicted with both eyes intact. Some images in the comics, however, do show his facial scar.
